task.description: ADHOC: Start all required backend services and apply pending migrations. test-env-verify reports C1 (db_test container unhealthy), C3 (migrate fails), C4 (cleanup fails), C6 (stale locks query fails). Root cause: db_test container is unhealthy. Run: (1) docker compose up -d db_test --wait  (2) Wait until docker compose ps shows db_test as healthy  (3) zig build migrate  (4) Re-run: .venv\Scripts\python.exe tools\verify_test_env.py (or zig build test-env-verify) and confirm exit 0 (all checks pass). Return PASS only when test-env-verify exits 0.
acceptance_criteria: docker compose ps db_test shows healthy

result.summary: db_test container started healthy (r-co-2-db_test-1, port 5453). zig build migrate: 124/124 applied (all skipped, already up to date). Fixed clean_test_db.py to fall back to docker-compose exec when psql.exe is absent on Windows (C4 was failing with FileNotFoundError). verify_test_env.py: 10/10 checks PASS, exit 0.

issues.description: psql.exe not installed on host; clean_test_db.py direct-URL mode failed with FileNotFoundError on Windows. Fixed by adding _psql_native_available() guard that falls back to docker-compose exec when no real psql binary exists.
